title: An uncontrolled memory access in the PDF import code of Apache OpenOffice versions through 4.1.16 allows a crafted PDF…
description: A vulnerability in Apache OpenOffice through version 4.1.16 allows crafted PDF files to trigger an out-of-bounds memory write in the PDF import code. This can cause the program to crash or result in memory corruption. The issue is fixed in version 4.1.17.
